evidence.quote: Keep fees separate, subject to court approval, with any reduction benefiting the class.
attorneys' fees $4,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Term sheet: class fund $30,000,000; attorneys' fees $4,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic

summary: Plaintiffs raised attorneys’ fees at the outset, and fee terms appeared in term sheets before the class relief was accepted. The transcript does not clearly show any trade of class recovery for fees, plaintiff self-interest, defense leverage of fee interest, or reverse-auction tactics. The declaration is not misleading on this record; it does not claim fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.
